title: नेपालको मौलिक संस्कृति : भीमसेन
nepali: काठमाडौं उपत्यकालाई थातथलोको रूपमा लिंदै आएका नेवारहरू नेपाल भित्र र बाहिर विभिन्न स्थानमा बसोबास गर्दै आइरहेका छन् । धार्मिक, सांस्कृतिक रूपमा विविधता रहेको यो समुदायले आफू बसेको स्थानमा मौलिक संस्कृतिको विकास गर्ने गरेका छन् । यो समुदायले आफू जहाँ बसेपनि भीमसेनलाई आफ्नो इष्टदेवताको रूपमा पूज्ने गर्छन् । विशेषगरी व्यापारी वर्गले भीमसेनलाई पूजा आराधना नगरी दिनचर्या नै शुरु गर्दैनन् । फलस्वरूप यो समुदायले आफू जहाँ बसेपनि साना–ठुला भीमसेनको मन्दिर  बनाउने गर्छन् । आस्था विश्वासका साथ पूजिंदै आएको भीमसेनलाई नेवार समुदायले मात्र व्यापारका देवताको रूपमा मात्र नरही आफ्नो पीडा कष्ट हटाउने देवताको रूपमा पनि लिने गरिन्छ । बलका देवताको रूपमा चिनिएका भीमसेनलाई कृषि र यौनका देवताको रूपमा समेत पूजिन्छ । फलस्वरूप नेवारहरूकोजीवनको अंगको रूपमा विकास गरेको भीमसेन पूजनलाई संस्कृतिको रूपमा नै विकास गरेको पाइन्छ ।
american_english: The Newars, who have traditionally regarded the Kathmandu Valley as their ancestral homeland, have been residing in various places both within and outside Nepal. Religiously and culturally diverse, this community has developed its own indigenous culture wherever they reside. Wherever they live, this community worships Bhimsen as their tutelary deity. In particular, the merchant class does not even begin their daily routine without offering worship and devotion to Bhimsen. Consequently, wherever this community resides, they build small and large temples dedicated to Bhimsen. Worshipped with deep faith and belief, Bhimsen is regarded by the Newar community not merely as the god of trade, but also as a deity who dispels their pain and hardship. Known as the deity of strength, Bhimsen is worshipped as the deity of agriculture and sexuality as well. As a result, the worship of Bhimsen, which developed as an integral part of Newar life, is found to have evolved into a culture in its own right.

informal_english: The Newars, who have always regarded the Kathmandu Valley as their ancestral home ground, have been living in various places both inside Nepal and overseas. Religiously and culturally diverse, this community has developed its own unique local culture wherever they settle down. Wherever they live, this community worships Bhimsen as their chosen family deity. In particular, the business crowd wouldn't even dream of kicking off their daily routine without worshipping and honouring Bhimsen first. As a result, wherever this community resides, they put up small and large temples dedicated to Bhimsen. Worshipped with heaps of faith and belief, Bhimsen is seen by the Newar community not merely as the god of trade, but also as the deity who sorts out their pain and troubles. Known far and wide as the god of brute strength, Bhimsen is worshipped as the deity of agriculture and sexuality as well. Consequently, the worship of Bhimsen, which developed as an integral part of Newar life, is found to have grown into a proper culture in its own right.
